growth_signal.value: Zeta has passed 13 million cumulative sign-ups as of September 2026 and just launched a new visual novel feature after a private beta.

entry.idea: People want to create and chat with their own custom characters and stories, so ScatterLab built Zeta, an app that lets users build AI characters and worlds and talk with them in real time.
entry.lesson: Let your users create and sell content inside your product, and it keeps growing your catalogue and your revenue without extra work from you.
entry.name: ScatterLab

growth.reason: 13 million cumulative sign-ups is a real number, but there is no data showing how fast that number is climbing.

market.reason: AI companion chat apps are already a big worldwide entertainment market, and Zeta runs in Korea, Japan and the US.

tech.reason: Generating matching character art, expressions and backgrounds live during a chat is a clever technical feat, but rival companion-AI apps could build something similar within a year or two.

entry.twist: Zeta just added a 'visual novel mode' where AI generates character art, expressions and changing backgrounds live to match the conversation, plus game-like choices and dice-roll events.
entry.who_pays: Users buy in-app content and premium features, and the company shares revenue with creators who sell character outfits they design.
entry.why_now: AI image generation is now fast and good enough to draw a fresh illustrated scene for every twist in a live conversation, turning plain text chat into an animated story.
